{{Quote|Beyond these stars exist other galaxies, other worlds, other beings.|[[Tenebrae]]|audio=VitiateOtherGalaxies.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Extragalactic''' or '''extra-galactic''' was a term for objects situated, occurring, or originating outside [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
[[File:YuuzhanVongWarrior-NJOS.png|thumb|right|150px|The Yuuzhan Vong believed they hailed from another galaxy, having spend eons in the intergalactic void.]]
Notable extra-galactic and alleged extra-galactic species included the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and the [[Chazrach]],<ref name="NJO">''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]''</ref> the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]],<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|139|DAT 1-4|Dathomir}}</ref> the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]] (originating in [[Firefist]]),<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and the [[Silentium]] and [[Abominor]] droid species<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> which may have originated in the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|Yuuzhan Vong's home galaxy]]. The [[Ship (sentient spacecraft)|sentient ship]] (and its pilot) [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] encountered also originated in another galaxy.<ref name="RITV">[[Star Wars (1977) 38|''Star Wars'' (1977) 38]]</ref>

The [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] had influence as far as the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]] and [[Firefist]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> 

The [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], when telling the [[Hero of Tython]] his plans for his galaxy-destroying ritual, said that there were other galaxies beyond theirs and that he would experience or ignore them as he wished. This implied that he, or the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], had means of reaching these locations&mdash;assuming the galaxy-destroying ritual would not also consume the [[Circumferential hyperspace barrier|hyperspace disturbance at the edge of the galaxy]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />

At some point during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] issued Intergalactic Passports to allow the owner to travel throughout the six known galaxies.<ref name="Intergalactic Passport real life artifact">[[Intergalactic Passport (real-life artifact)|Intergalactic Passport]]</ref> In addition, [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] in a guest lecture for the [[Brionelle Memorial Military Academy]] speculated that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] by the time of his resurrection and ruling of the [[Dark Empire]] may have planned to eventually engage in extra-galactic conquest due to his usage of [[World Devastator]]s.<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
